A burrow entrance nestled between thick roots, a round door hung with cobweb netting, a pumpkin-seed welcome mat fanned across the threshold; acorn-cap lanterns line the root-steps above, each one brimming with amber warmth; the soft earth path curves away into gentle pearl mist.

A vine rope-ladder climbs the bark to an owlet's hollow, each rung draped with a single cobweb strand beaded with dew, tiny mushroom lanterns pegged along the trunk like a glowing trail; the hollow opening spills warm amber light onto the bark below; the canopy above dissolves into indigo and soft silver.

A fungus-ringed fairy circle clusters beside the hollow, thumb-sized acorn-cap stools arranged around a bead-sized glowing mushroom centerpiece casting jack-o'-lantern warmth; cobweb lace is looped between the largest toadstools like a festive canopy; the hollow doorway behind glows softly in autumnal amber.

A root-cellar entrance tucks beneath the great hollow tree, a cobweb curtain veiling the low door, stacked acorn-shell barrels to either side, a mushroom lantern hung above casting amber warmth on the mossy lintel; stepping-stones of bark lead to the foreground; the tree trunk soars upward into soft purple dusk.

A cracked acorn-shell mailbox leans beside a mossy hollow doorway strung with thread-thin cobweb lace, a bead-sized amber mushroom lantern hung from the lintel; a twig-fence border lines the soft-earth path inward; the surrounding roots and fern dissolve into a warm harvest-moon haze.

A tiny watchtower perches on a broken branch-stub, cobweb pennants fluttering at each corner, a matchbox-sized amber lantern aglow at the top; a bark-plank catwalk bridges the tower to the main hollow knot-hole window spilling warm orange light; the canopy falls away into misty violet.

A twilight spiral of acorn-cap lanterns lines a winding path upward to the hollow's door, each cap brimming with amber warmth like tiny jack-o'-lanterns; cobweb lace is looped along the root-rail beside the path; the hollow door stands ajar, a thread of golden light pooling on the moss.

A moss-covered mushroom dome cluster nestles beside the hollow like a friendly little cottage annex, a bead-sized amber lantern glowing inside each cap; cobweb lace curtains the gap between dome and bark like a pretty window dressing; the woodland floor softens into silver-misted autumn.

A lantern-lit root-bridge arches over a shallow puddle-pond, the harvest moon reflected in the still water below, amber mushroom lanterns strung on cobweb thread along each side; a single fallen leaf the size of a thumbnail floats at the near bank; the far shore dissolves into warm copper haze.

A curled fallen log porch holds a mushroom cluster table set with thimble-sized acorn-cap cups, a thread-thin cobweb tablecloth draped precisely over the edge, a matchbox amber lantern glowing at the center; a lantern-lined path leads through moss to the hollow doorway behind; soft indigo mist wraps the distance.

A hollow tree exterior glows from its knot-hole window in deep amber-orange, gnarled root-archways framing the foreground like welcoming arms, cobweb lace strung between each root like a garland; a ring of bead-sized glowing mushrooms circles the base; the trunk reaches upward into harvest-moon-softened sky.
